title: Candidate
description: Something that could fill a need, found in a source catalog: its licence, releases and activity as the registry gives them, and its fit and outcome as a choice records them.

registry.description: the source catalog it came from (a component in system sources): github, deps-dev, ...

licence.description: SPDX identifier as the registry reports it

latest_release.description: the newest release that is not a pre-release

last_push.description: the last push to its repository (YYYY-MM-DD)

fit.description: what it does, against the need

trial.description: what it did in the trial

reason.description: why it was picked or rejected
